answer_1.quote: Event Relation Extraction (ERE) includes identifying coreference, temporal, causal, and subevent relations between every two events in the text.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are event relation labels (e.g., coreference, temporal, causal, subevent) for pairs of events in a given text.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the averaged micro-F1 score as the evaluation metric and also report the logical inconsistency metric LI (defined in Section 2.2) on ERE datasets.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are asked to review 100 predictions generated by ChatGPT and mark the error types.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are instructed to mark error types based on whether the rationale is wrong (CE1), incomplete (CE2), or redundant (CE3) compared to true logical constraints, and whether the reasoning process exhibits wrong start (FE1) or wrong process (FE2).
